runtime: Rootless Podman; no external network or host mounts; ordinary acceptance user
redaction: Session identity replaced consistently; message bodies, working directory and other session values omitted. Schemas and numeric/time/model fields retained.
version_basis: Product version is capture provenance; carrier schema has no per-row product version, so goose-usage-ledger-1 remains a format anchor.
limitations: One CLI response without extensions or compaction only. No desktop, subagents, rewind/fork, old schema or other-version real acceptance.
Cache write, cost and reasoning remain unknown; missing fields do not become zero.
Provider identity is not guessed from the session provider or model name.
